introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.description: Solaris UI is an institutional Angular UI framework: strict for maintainers, simple for consumers. Start here to understand the principles before installing.

ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

principles.note: Consistency by default — every product starts credible.
principles.trustDesc: Visitors judge in seconds; Solaris components sweat the details.
principles.contractDesc: Rigid contracts for maintainers, a small stable API for consumers.
principles.docsDesc: Live examples and guidance in three languages.

contracts.standaloneDesc: No NgModules; import only what you use.
contracts.signalsDesc: Signals with OnPush for predictable rendering.
contracts.tokensDesc: No raw values — everything resolves through --solaris-* tokens.
contracts.a11yDesc: ARIA semantics, keyboard support, and visible focus.
contracts.motionDesc: Honors prefers-reduced-motion; motion is never the only signal.
contracts.i18nDesc: Every string in pt-BR, en-US, and es-419.

next.installDesc: Add the package, wire styles and providers.
next.iconsDesc: Searchable icon registry with usage guidance.
